title: The Swing Count That Skipped a Name
youtube_title: The Swing Count That Skipped a Name | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying beside someone is sometimes the whole gift.
summary: At a bedroom rug of cushions, puppets, and paper, Ximena is just outside the fun, close to a swing count that skipped a name. Kei changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Ximena has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Papa lets the children solve it.
